blocks.md:
## Filter in the page

The list is already in the tree. On `input` of `#q`, hide `li` nodes whose text does not include the query (case-insensitive). Use a class or `hidden` — do not rebuild innerHTML from a string of names.

Typing `ea` should hide `North` and leave `East` visible. The filter tray already holds the names. You only show or hide them.
